newsitem.title: UK: European bunkers steady but demand stays thin.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers steady but demand stays thin.

text.p: European bunker fuel prices were steady on Wednesday with prices for heavy fuel oil and diesel in the key ARA spot market steady to firmer but outright demand for bunker fuels stayed thin, brokers said.
One broker said bunker demand was limited to around 10,000 tonnes.
"The market is exceptionally quiet. There were very small trades at high numbers, like in the past two days," he said.
Rotterdam 380 cst bunkers were valued around $86 fob in line with prices on the ARA barge market.
In Hamburg brokers reported a continuing lull in demand but said the generally steady sentiment of the spot markets was underpinning prices.
380 cst bunkers talked a steady $91/92 with diesel slightly firmer at $162/$165 a tonne delivered.
In the Mediterranean fuel oil was steady to soft, while gas oil and diesel prices held steady after rising in most ports on Tuesday. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
